dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahaha, these books are actually pretty good. I bet the boys in the gang would enjoy reading 'em, too.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? ...Fairytales? You mean... they're meant for kids?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ahem! Uhh, what I meant was, we should totally share these books with the kids in the city! They'd be a smash hit with them!
